# State Class View (variant): Environmental engineer (local)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Environmental engineer (`emst:core/ROL-Y2VGWPS`, P2); authority position (editorial): regulated-party
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.3.0, rule state-class-view@0.2.0 (registered rule, status active), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped at skos:closeMatch or stronger in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Practice within licensure scope and responsible charge — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Draft enforceable, implementable binding instruments — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Build, calibrate and validate predictive and simulation models of environmental systems — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Supervise automated and AI-assisted process control in environmental operations — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Investigate and manage emerging contaminants across media — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Protect operational technology at environmental utilities and facilities — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Assess human health risks from environmental exposures — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Direct and evaluate applicant- or contractor-prepared environmental documents — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
